fx8_riser.title: Endless Riser
fx8_riser.note: Shepard riser: octave-spaced tones that climb forever, a noise swell on top; stops dead on the downbeat, 4 bars at 128 BPM

fx8_uplift.title: Uplifter
fx8_uplift.note: noise through a resonant band-pass sweeping up five octaves, with a phaser; 2 bars at 128 BPM

fx8_down.title: Downlifter
fx8_down.note: noise sweeping down with a falling sub, 2 bars at 128 BPM

fx8_backspin.title: Backspin
fx8_backspin.note: a bar of the groove-house chords and drums pulled backwards and slowing to a stop

fx8_impact.title: Tech Impact
fx8_impact.note: sub drop, distorted crack and a long dark tail

fx8_crash.title: Crash Into Reverb
fx8_crash.note: a crash into a long hall for transitions
